item.title: Man charged in Feb. 25 Chatham stabbing: Chatham-Kent police
item.description: A local man has been charged after a Chatham stabbing last month, Chatham-Kent police say. Officers called to a Thames Street residence in Chatham Feb. 25 found a male visitor with multiple stab wounds to his legs, police said. Investigation revealed the male was sleeping when an individual entered the bedroom, stabbed him three times […]

item.title: Team founder Dom Dinelle to manage Chatham-Kent Barnstormers
item.description: President, CEO and co-owner Dom Dinelle is the new manager of the Chatham-Kent Barnstormers.

item.title: Tree haircut: What’s in store for Chatham-Kent trees?
item.description: If you’ve seen a lot of tree trimming going on across Chatham-Kent in recent days there is a reason. item.title: Buxton Speedway hosts muddy late-winter car race
item.description: Milder late-winter temperatures turned what is typically a snowy race into a muddy grind on Saturday at Buxton Speedway, a raceway near Chatham.
